description: Browser webviews (label browser-*) hold an empty capability set: no invoke, no event listeners, no filesystem, no shell. This file exists to declare that deny-by-default posture in the open — a label no capability mentions would be equally safe and much easier to widen by accident. src-tauri/src/browser.rs parses this file and fails the build's test leg if any permission is ever added here, or if any other capability's window/webview globs start reaching browser labels. Matched on `webviews`, not `windows`: a browser page is a child webview of the main window, and a window-matched grant would be inherited by every child seated in it.
